title: Remove unprovenanced UI reference document
summary: Remove the unprovenanced Refactoring UI DOCX, retain only a lawful official-site reference, and enforce a source-control boundary against Office working documents under active documentation.
reason: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W13-003. The tracked 71,272-byte DOCX contains a substantial conversion of paid third-party publication text, has no repository redistribution-permission record, and is distributed by Git even though portable packages exclude it.
behavior_before: Git tracked docs/ui/Refactoring_UI_text_only.docx, while the portable-release policy only excluded it from deployable packages. Source intake had no check preventing the same or another opaque Office working document from being committed below docs/.
behavior_after: The unprovenanced DOCX is absent, docs/ui/README.md links only to the official source and states the repository policy, and all shared source-tree audit suites fail closed when Git tracks a present Office working document below docs/.
